reply_text:
I didn't record 382 seats for Marrow Agrisupply because our records say 40. I replied to Tobias in the #central-team thread to point out the mismatch.

- The Affiliate Amendment (signed 2025-10-02, effective 2025-10-15) set Marrow Agrisupply at 40 seats.
- The 2026 renewal order form (signed 22 Apr 2026, effective 1 May 2026) leaves Marrow Agrisupply's seats as the amendment set them.
- The Marrow Agrisupply account page, last updated 2026-09-15, also says 40 seats.

In the reply I asked Tobias whether 382 is a new figure, such as a pending true-up or a new amendment, and to point me to the document if so. Until he does, I'm treating 40 as the current count.

All three sources are Central team files, so Tobias can see them himself. My reply gives only seat counts and dates, no prices.
